input: computer-use sky.drag, real OS mouse input into isolated test windows
captureUnits: logical pixels of the captured native window, including its visible frame; not browser CSS dimensions
earlierAttempts: Async JS initiation and Chromium-child hit tests failed real side drags despite synthetic checks. Final implementation reserves a Form-owned band and delegates its real non-client input to Windows.
limitations: Observed on one physical 200% DPI Windows desktop; other DPI/multi-monitor hardware not tested
Drags used the outer native border; do not infer that every inner CSS pixel is a native resize target
No continuous video or frame-by-frame flicker measurement; still captures only establish resulting geometry
